_comment: Newest first is computed from date. kind: announcement | stage-report | note. Entries with template: true are layout previews and must be removed before publishing. Numbers must come from the run's own records.

updates.title: Public screening of ICLR 2027 starts tonight
updates.summary: Stage 1 starts at 9:00 PM ET. Five sessions run at once, started a few at a time. Each paper is checked against earlier public work, and every step is shown on the live page.
